title: I'd say 500k is the annual revenue to be legit lifestyle business. We do around 75-200k a year but it ain't enough to go full time. Still a side gig.
summary: I'd say 500k is the annual revenue to be legit lifestyle business. We do around 75-200k a year but it ain't enough to go full time. Still a side gig. I am quite curious to see when OATV closes its first @indievc fund and we have data comparing returns on real businesses and venture backed ideas.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I'd say 500k is the annual revenue to be legit lifestyle business. We do around 75-200k a year but it ain't enough to go full time. Still a side gig.

I am quite curious to see when OATV closes its first @indievc fund and we have data comparing returns on real businesses and venture backed ideas.
